claim: TTP X(z*) 是 E|_(S^2)^9 的临界点（D3h 对称约化 + E'(z*)=0，L1–L3），其 Riemannian Hessian 在 15 维商切空间（18 维切空间模 3 维 SO(3) 轨道方向）上严格正定：q_z*(v,v) ≥ 0.14378982·‖v‖² 对一切 v ∈ S_A(z*)（L4–L7），核恰为旋转轨道方向（L5/L6 精确恒等式 + L7 排除其余核）⇒ 模 SO(3) 的非退化严格局部极小（L8，二阶充分条件）
manifold: (S^2)^9 subset R^27; tangent 18-dim (27 coords minus 9 unit-sphere constraints); SO(3) orbit directions 3-dim; quotient 15-dim
method: mpmath.iv interval arithmetic (dps=50) over the whole z* isolation interval I; reduced coordinates in the pointwise-orthogonal tangent basis {e_theta, e_m} (Gram exactly diag(1, 1/rho^2) on triangles, 1 on caps); Riemannian Hessian assembled pair-by-pair (36 pairs + 9 second-fundamental-form corrections, q_z(v,v) = v^T H_amb v - sum_i (grad_i E . x_i)|v_i|^2); criticality of X(z*) by D3h symmetry reduction (fixed ambient subspace F_amb intersect tangent = span{family direction}, grad E . v_fam = E'(z*) = 0 from R1); rotation kernel q(w,w)=0 and vanishing cross terms are exact SO(3)-invariance identities at the critical point (numerically cross-checked ~1e-6 ~ |E'| scale); the 15-dim quotient subspace is built at the interval midpoint (rotation-orthogonalized pivoted Gram-Schmidt, fixed coefficient matrix A0), transversality T = S_A (+) R certified on all of I via interval Cholesky of the G-metric Gram; the certificate M(z) - lambda*Ghat(z) ≻ 0 uses the MEAN-VALUE FORM M(z) ⊆ M(z_mid) + [A0^T Q'(I) A0](z - z_mid) with the z-derivative Q' obtained by dual interval automatic differentiation (cross-checked against central differences), keeping entry widths ~1e-5 (the true variation of M over I); final certification uses a preconditioned congruence: the midpoint matrix is factored by a high-precision concrete Cholesky R and the interval Cholesky runs on R^{-1}(M - lambda*Ghat)R^{-T} ~ I + small, which avoids the quadratic degradation of plain interval Cholesky (certified lambda within ~1e-4 of the numeric lambda_min instead of ~7e-3)
kernelDescription: 18 维切空间上 ker(q) = R = span{w^x, w^y, w^z}（SO(3) 轨道切场 w^a_i = e_a×x_i），恰 3 维：q(w,w)=0 与交叉项 sᵀHw = 0 是临界点处 SO(3) 不变性的精确恒等式（L5/L6；区间复核 |C_RᵀQ_redC_R|、|Q_redC_R| ≤ 1e-3，实测 ~1e-6 = |E'| 量级，随 z→z* 收敛到 0）；15 维商切空间上核为空（区间 Cholesky 证书 M(z) − λ·Ĝ(z) ≻ 0 排除一切非旋转核方向）。D3h 点群不产生额外零方向：族方向 v_fam（A1' 不可约；在 z_mid 处 ⊥R 故含于 S_A(z_mid) 的构造中，z* 处经 T = S_A⊕R 分解被证书覆盖）的曲率由两路独立确认——q(v_fam,v_fam) 区间与 E″(I) 区间相交（共同值 E″(z*)≈42.859，E″ 来自 local_min.py 的独立闭式自动微分）

lemmaChain.L1_isolation: E' sign change on I + E''>0 on I: unique z* with E'(z*)=0 (re-verified here via local_min.E_dual; R1 artifact interval re-derived and matched)
lemmaChain.L2_fixedSubspace: F_amb ∩ T = span{v_fam}, v_fam = -(z/rho)*f1 + f2 exactly; f1, f3 non-tangent (dot enclosures bounded away from 0)
lemmaChain.L3_criticality: grad E in F_amb (D3h equivariance of ∇E) and grad E . v_fam = E'(z*) = 0 ⇒ X(z*) critical on (S^2)^9; numeric: tangential-gradient basis dots contain 0, max ~ |E'| scale
lemmaChain.L4_riemannianHessian: q_z(v,v) = v^T H_amb v - sum_i (grad_i E . x_i)|v_i|^2 (geodesic acceleration of unit spheres); at a critical point this is the Riemannian Hessian
lemmaChain.L5_kernelOnRotations: q(w,w) = 0 exactly at z* (SO(3) invariance); numeric |C_R^T Q_red C_R| ~ 1e-6 ~ |E'|
lemmaChain.L6_crossTerms: s^T H w = 0 exactly at z*; numeric |Q_red C_R| ~ 1e-6
lemmaChain.L7_intervalCertificate: basis tangency; dim R = 3 (C_R^T G C_R PD); midpoint-built A0 (18x15) with Gram_G([A0|C_R]) PD on all of I ⇒ T = S_A ⊕ R; mean-value form + dual-AD derivative certifies M(z) - λGhat(z) PD by interval Cholesky ⇒ q_z ≥ λ||·||² on S_A(z) for ALL z ∈ I
lemmaChain.L8_conclusion: at z*: u = s + r ⇒ q(u) = q(s) ≥ λ||s||² ≥ λ·dist(u,R)² ⇒ ker Hess = R exactly; quotient lambda_min ≥ λ > 0 ⇒ nondegenerate strict local minimum modulo SO(3) (second-order sufficient condition)
